execution_gates.pass_condition: The named operator must document jurisdiction, KYC status, derivatives eligibility, account mode, API eligibility, tax obligations, and any restrictions. Public data access is never accepted as evidence of legal trading access.

Metadata must cover all of 2023-2024, enumerate incidents, and bind dataset export state. A later credentialed census must prove at least 95 percent complete calendar days and 90 percent complete months without inferring any missing event.

Aurex must deterministically reconcile collateral, premiums, trading and delivery fees, realized and unrealized cash flows, option and hedge positions, margin, balances, settlement, and currency conversion without implicit borrowing.

Every option event must bind to exact instrument, underlying index, hedge instrument, exchange timestamp, local timestamp, expiry, and delivery clock under a no-forward-fill policy with explicit stale-state invalidation.

Tardis metadata must expose every frozen data type for the exact OPTIONS and BTC-PERPETUAL dataset symbols, and all 27 first-day HEAD requests must return unambiguous successful identities and nonzero projected content lengths.

Aurex must reproduce point-in-time option Greeks and underlying inputs without future data, define discrete hedge timing before outcomes, cap unhedged delta/gamma/vega, and halt on stale or missing option, index, Greek, or hedge state.

The option and hedge legs must use unique client IDs and explicit acknowledge, reject, partial fill, cancel, timeout, and unknown transitions. No atomic fill assumption is allowed; bounded rollback, emergency flattening, and halt rules must be testable.

A later payload pilot must preserve disconnect markers, sequence or prev_change_id recovery, fresh snapshots, local byte hashes, gzip integrity, and upstream revision identity. CSV files alone cannot satisfy disconnect recovery because they omit disconnects.

Every frozen hedge source product must exist with exchange and local timestamps, executable bid/ask quantities, trades, index and derivative state, and later sequence-aware recovery. Underlying candles, marks, or midpoints cannot substitute for hedge fills.

Grouped option quotes and book snapshots must cover every active instrument with executable bid and ask quantities, exchange and local timestamps, and a later raw sequence/recovery source. Marks, midpoints, model values, and trade-only evidence are prohibited.

The source foundation must enumerate all active and expired BTC options with listing, expiry, strike, put/call type, contract size, tick and amount rules, underlying index, settlement currency, and delivery semantics at each point in time.

Grouped option trade and liquidation products must exist across the frozen dates and later prove complete identity, timestamp, side, amount-schema, and incident coverage without using trade prices as a substitute for executable BBO.

Dated evidence must bind each option and hedge contract's size, tick, amount, expiry, exercise, delivery price, index composition, settlement, and currency rules throughout 2023-2024. Current documentation cannot be projected backward.

A complete dated 2023-2024 fee record must establish option and hedge maker/taker fees, option fee caps, delivery, settlement and liquidation fees, account tier, and fee currency. Current or estimated fees are hard failures.

Dated evidence must reproduce standard or portfolio margin, collateral and haircut rules, liquidation thresholds and process, insurance treatment, account mode, and cross-position effects for every simulated state. Current rules cannot substitute.

Before returns, Aurex must cap displayed-liquidity participation, spread, open interest, strike/expiry concentration, unhedged Greeks, margin usage, daily loss, and worst-case tail loss, with no automatic rearm after stale data or reconciliation breach.

All 28 census requests must complete inside frozen zero-retry budgets, projected 2023-2024 storage must remain below the 2 TiB ceiling, and a credible subscription, transfer, checksum, storage, and replay plan must be approved before any dataset or raw payload GET is authorized.

limitations: CSV datasets omit disconnect events; a later raw pilot is mandatory for disconnect and sequence recovery.
Content-Length is a storage projection, not proof of gzip, row, timestamp, symbol, quote, trade, or option-chain integrity.
Current Deribit instrument, fee, margin, liquidation, delivery, and settlement documentation is not historical 2023-2024 truth.
Grouped OPTIONS data must later be cross-bound to BTC-PERPETUAL hedge and index state at exchange and local timestamps.
No dataset payload, raw replay, Deribit API request, credential, retry, range, or resume is authorized; dataset HEAD redirects are limited to three manually validated public HTTPS hops.
No mark, midpoint, model value, Greek, trade, or candle may be used as an assumed executable option or hedge fill.
No parameter, price, Greek, margin value, signal, trade, P/L, return, candidate, validation, paper, sandbox, live, or capital permission exists.
Public source access does not establish operator jurisdiction, KYC, derivatives eligibility, account mode, or API access.
The option strategy is negatively convex and passing source headers would not establish bounded tail loss or profitability.
The three first-of-month dates are bounded source probes and do not establish 95 percent daily or 90 percent monthly completeness.
This contract performs one public metadata GET and 27 public zero-body HEAD requests only; it cannot inspect dataset schemas.
